title: minglejiang/Mail-Bench
abstract: # MAIL-Bench **MAIL-Bench: Benchmarking Robotic Manipulation under Visual Availability Interruptions and Loss** MAIL-Bench measures how an embodied manipulation policy behaves when one or more cameras become unavailable partway through a task: can it still finish, at what phase of the task does it start to fail, and how does its completion efficiency change. It evaluates one fixed multi-task policy on RoboCasa Atomic-Seen (18 tasks x 50 frozen scenes), with vision lost at 30 %, 45 % or 60 % of the policy's own healthy completion step in one of three visual roles (wrist, agentview, all vision). Any model design and training method are allowed. The protocol, the scoring rule and the validity conditions are in [`docs/MAIL_BENCH_PROTOCOL.md`](docs/MAIL_BENCH_PROTOCOL.md). ## Reference results | Policy | Reported | H | Wrist .30/.45/.60 | Agentview .30/.45/.60 | All vision .30/.45/.60 | S_MAIL | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | pi0.5 (RoboCasa multitask) | 0.396 | 0.402 | 0.165 / 0.219 / 0.307 | 0.340 / 0.365 / 0.476 | 0.038 / 0.086 / 0.176 | **0.257** | | GR00T N1.5 (RoboCasa365 official) | 0.507 | 0.450 | 0.165 / 0.267 / 0.377 | 0.247 / 0.285 / 0.407 | 0.048 / 0.089 / 0.124 | **0.246** | "Reported" is the Atomic-Seen success each checkpoint's publisher reports under their own protocol. The records are in `results/`; the table is generated by The two reference servers, `scripts/pi05_robocasa_policy_server.py` (openpi + JAX, port 7606) and `scripts/groot15_robocasa_policy_server.py` (torch, port 7614), are complete examples of the policy contract. ## Installing Running a cohort also needs RoboCasa365 at the revision pinned in `configs/dataset_registry.yaml`, its MuJoCo renderer with EGL, a GPU for the policy server and `zstd`. The benchmark runs from a git checkout: every run records the checkout's commit and refuses a dirty worktree, so keep the virtual environment outside the checkout or name it `.venv/`. ## Running the official pipeline `--phase all` runs
abstract_zh: MAIL-Bench 衡量具身操作策略在任务进行中一个或多个摄像头不可用时的表现：它是否仍能完成任务、在哪个阶段开始失败，以及完成效率如何变化。该基准在 RoboCasa Atomic-Seen（18 个任务 × 50 个冻结场景）上评估一个固定的多任务策略，在策略自身健康完成步数的 30%、45% 或 60% 处丢失视觉，涉及三种视觉角色（腕部、代理视角、全部视觉）之一。允许任何模型设计和训练方法。协议、评分规则和有效性条件见 docs/MAIL_BENCH_PROTOCOL.md。
tldr_zh: 基准测试机器人操作在视觉中断下的表现与失效阶段。
cover_zh: 摄像头中途罢工？这个基准测出机器人何时开始翻车
